svg.title: Prasad Light Fighter - interpreted silhouette
svg.desc: Traders and Gunboats (2024), printed 130, PDF 131. Plan exterior preserves small flat sensor nose, two separate wing pairs, slender connecting body and tapered central stern. Forward wingtip tabs and broad rear aerofoils retained. Illustration corroborates paired wings. Vertical fins, fine weapon detail and internal compartments excluded.
